question: **Select the most appropriate option for blank number 2.**
solution:
The correct answer is option 2) i.e. 'leaving.'

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• Let's look at the meaning of the words given in the options:

 
 
 

 Word
 Meaning
 
 
 
 

 leaves 
 to go away from someone or something, for a short time or permanently (used with the singular form of the subject)
 
 

 leaving 
 the continuous form of leave
 
 

 left
 the past form of leave
 
 

 leave
 to go away from someone or something, for a short time or permanently
 
 
 
 

 

 
• The context of the sentence is that the swarm of desert locusts is advancing towards India they are eating up crops and grasslands thus destructing the vegetation.
 
• Here, we have to use the **gerund (verb+ing) **form of leave **'leaving'** as this part of the sentence is a separate part and we have to start the sentence with a gerund.
 
• According to the above-mentioned points, the most appropriate word to fill the blank is "leaving."
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is Option 2.

​

Complete passage:__ *Swarms of the desert locust, which invaded India via Pakistan in April, have made __(1) their__ way to at least five states, (__2) leaving__ a trail of destruction in their (__3) wake__. Desert locusts move in large groups, (__4) called__ swarms, and can eat crops up (__5) to__ their own weight every day. When millions of __(6) locusts__ descend on a crop, they destroy __(7) everything__. The desert locust is considered the __(8) most__ destructive migratory pest in the world __(9) since__ a single swarm covering one square kilometre can __(10) contain__ up to 80 million locusts. As per eyewitnesses, the swarm which entered India from Pakistan was about two to three kilometres long.*
